annotations.title: TIA — create OB by event class

description: Creates an organization block (OB) of an event class (eventClass is one of the 15 listed). Gd6: put the LOGIC in afterwards via tia_source_put (SCL/STL) or tia_import_xml (LAD/FBD). `number` optional: omitted → the class's base number when free, else the lowest free one in 123..32767 (non-singleton classes only). An explicit number must be one Siemens permits for the class: ProgramCycle 1 or 123+, Startup 100 or 123+, TimeOfDay 10-17 or 123+, TimeDelayInterrupt 20-23 or 123+, CyclicInterrupt 30-38 or 123+, HardwareInterrupt 40-47 or 123+. Singleton classes (Status, Update, Profile, TimeErrorInterrupt, DiagnosticErrorInterrupt, PullOrPlugOfModules, RackOrStationFailure, ProgrammingError, IOAccessError) hold ONE OB, with the base number: a second one is refused with 409 ob_singleton_exists (details.existing = the OB that holds it). Other refusals: 400 invalid_event_class (details.validClasses), 400 invalid_ob_number (not an integer, outside 1..32767, or not permitted for the class: details.allowed lists the permitted ranges), 409 ob_number_in_use (details.usedBy), 409 ob_number_exhausted, 409 name_collision (details.collidesWith). dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns the plan {number, eventClass, language, group, createsGroup} WITHOUT creating anything. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/obs. M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

group.description: target block group (default: the program-blocks root)

number.description: OB number ≥1, permitted for the class (omitted ⇒ chosen from the event class)
